class: A builder for a younger row is dispatched into its own worktree without running the binding overlap gate (ADR-171 rule 3) against every older open row, so two rows in flight edit the same file and the older row's fix round collides with the younger row's work.
mechanism: Row 18's build worktree was cut from the chunk head after row 17's code merged and its builder was dispatched at once; row 18's brief lists backend/ofo_app/routes/outcome.py, which row 17 changed (B1b) and then had to change again in its fix round (90d3a2bc) while row 18's builder edited the same file. The gate is a manual command in the contract; nothing forces it before an Agent dispatch.

first_seen.evidence: overlap_gate.py ran for row 19 (exit 0, later exit 2 on tests_app/test_response_door.py) but not for row 18; row 18's brief lists routes/outcome.py; row 17 fix commit 90d3a2bc touches the same file.

fix: Instance: row 18 merges the chunk head (with row 17's fix) before its check; the two edits are in different hunks. Class fix proposed (the NEXT chunk's process-tool slot, ADR-178 freeze): a dispatch hook refuses a builder brief whose worktree is a row-ahead worktree unless a recent overlap_gate.py OK line for that worktree and planned-files list is recorded.
